scope: Construction and acceptance of one explicitly selected potable-water distribution main DPM-HDPE-PE100-RC-SDR17-OD225-PN10, 1800 m long, including the approved trench and bedding schedule, pipe joints, fittings, isolation valves, fire hydrants, chambers, warning tape, thrust restraint, flushing, pressure testing, disinfection, potable-water analysis, labor, equipment, records and logistics.
sourceAuthority: Approved potable-water distribution-main plan and profile, hydraulic calculation, geotechnical report, pipe-system and appurtenance schedules, bill of quantities, method statement, testing and disinfection program, accredited water laboratory, suppliers and approving project engineer

conditionalBranches.crossingCasing: NOT_REQUIRED unless an approved crossing detail requires a casing
conditionalBranches.groundwaterDewatering: NOT_REQUIRED unless the geotechnical and method documents require dewatering
conditionalBranches.roadReinstatement: NOT_REQUIRED unless the approved alignment and reinstatement schedule require it

exclusions: complete village or settlement network, house connections, internal plumbing, sewer and stormwater systems
length-derived trench, fittings, valves, hydrants, chambers, labor, equipment or logistics
automatic selection of crossings, dewatering, road reinstatement, retained spare or supplier segment length
unapproved materials, equipment, quantities and prices
